items.title: 3 Defensive Dividend Stocks for Retirees Worried About the Next Market Downturn
items.summary: Phone plans, cancer drugs, and pipeline tolls keep getting paid when the economy stalls. Three low-beta dividend payers each carry one risk that could undercut the income, and only one of them is easy to spot.
